reviews.method: Mechanical usage sweep: transitive closure over crates/*/Cargo.toml fs-* dependency edges from every supported-workflow root (all *-e2e lanes plus the named verticals/campaigns and fs-cli), counting runtime AND dev-dependency edges. A crate outside that closure is exercised by no supported workflow.

validation.known_exercised_control: fs-sparse (17 dependent crates) is reached and not flagged
validation.zero_dependent_spot_checks: fs-airflow and fs-rep-voxel confirmed to have no dependent crate anywhere

capability_cross_reference.note: Sweep independently corroborates the registry boundary "Not L3 -- no e2e lane exercises it".

Registered L1 wasm.browser-flagships. Disposition is deliberately NOT "freeze" because that would imply a green parked state that does not exist.

residual_concerns: The sweep proves absence of a dependency EDGE from a workflow root, not absence of use: a crate exercised only through a doc example, a binary, or a non-crate harness would still be flagged.
Roots are a curated list; adding a workflow root changes the candidate set, so the root list is part of the reviewed record rather than an implementation detail.

Every candidate was committed within the preceding ~3 weeks and all but two ship test files. This inventory is "not yet composed into a workflow", NOT "abandoned" -- which is why KEEP is the default disposition and no RETIRE is proposed in this review.
